title: MasteringSettings
description: Mastering DSP parameters shared by frontend and backend. Generated from the MasteringParameters Pydantic model — do not edit by hand; run gen_mastering_schema.py instead.

clarity_wet.description: Reverb wet/dry mix for M/S spatial processing. 0 = dry, 1 = full reverb.

clarity_brightness_db.description: High-frequency boost/cut at 8 kHz. Positive = brighter air.

limiter_ceiling_db.description: True-peak limiter ceiling in dBFS. -0.3 = loud, -3.0 = safe.

transient_boost_db.description: Transient emphasis via wet compression mix. 0 = off, 6 = max punch.

saturation_drive_db.description: Harmonic saturation drive (THD level). 0 = clean, 10 = heavy tape.

saturation_warmth_db.description: Warmth — gentle high-frequency roll-off (negative) or air boost (positive).

stereo_width.description: Mid/Side stereo width multiplier. 1.0 = original, 2.0 = double width.

haas_delay_ms.description: Haas (precedence) effect delay on Side signal in ms. 0 = off.

stereo_imaging_enabled.description: Enable the per-band stereo imaging stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

stereo_imaging_mono_below_hz.description: Force low frequencies below this to mono center. 0 = off.

output_bit_depth.description: Output bit depth. 16 applies noise-shaped dithering; 24+ is transparent.

target_lufs_db.description: Explicit loudness target in LUFS (e.g. -14 Spotify, -16 Apple). None = derive automatically from limiter ceiling.

multiband_enabled.description: Enable the LR4 multiband compressor stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

multiband_crossover_low_hz.description: Low/mid Linkwitz-Riley crossover frequency in Hz.

multiband_crossover_high_hz.description: Mid/high Linkwitz-Riley crossover frequency in Hz.

dyn_eq_enabled.description: Enable the dynamic EQ stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

dyn_eq_band1_freq_hz.description: Dynamic EQ band 1 center frequency (roadmap resonance case).

dyn_eq_band1_threshold_db.description: Dynamic EQ band 1 threshold in dBFS.

dyn_eq_band1_ratio.description: Dynamic EQ band 1 ratio. 1.0 = no cut (neutral).

dyn_eq_band2_freq_hz.description: Dynamic EQ band 2 center frequency in Hz.

dyn_eq_band2_threshold_db.description: Dynamic EQ band 2 threshold in dBFS.

dyn_eq_band2_ratio.description: Dynamic EQ band 2 ratio. 1.0 = no cut (neutral).

dyn_eq_band3_freq_hz.description: Dynamic EQ band 3 center frequency in Hz.

dyn_eq_band3_threshold_db.description: Dynamic EQ band 3 threshold in dBFS.

dyn_eq_band3_ratio.description: Dynamic EQ band 3 ratio. 1.0 = no cut (neutral).

exciter_enabled.description: Enable the harmonic exciter stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

exciter_band1_mode.description: Exciter band 1 (bass) harmonic curve: even, odd, or mix.

exciter_band1_amount.description: Exciter band 1 (bass) dry/wet mix of the excited content. 0.0 = neutral.

exciter_band1_drive_db.description: Exciter band 1 (bass) drive in dB for the odd/tanh path.

exciter_band1_low_cut_hz.description: Exciter band 1 (bass) high-pass on the excited content in Hz.

exciter_band2_mode.description: Exciter band 2 (tube) harmonic curve: even, odd, or mix.

exciter_band2_amount.description: Exciter band 2 (tube) dry/wet mix of the excited content. 0.0 = neutral.

exciter_band2_drive_db.description: Exciter band 2 (tube) drive in dB for the odd/tanh path.

exciter_band2_low_cut_hz.description: Exciter band 2 (tube) high-pass on the excited content in Hz.

exciter_band3_mode.description: Exciter band 3 (tape) harmonic curve: even, odd, or mix.

exciter_band3_amount.description: Exciter band 3 (tape) dry/wet mix of the excited content. 0.0 = neutral.

exciter_band3_drive_db.description: Exciter band 3 (tape) drive in dB for the odd/tanh path.

exciter_band3_low_cut_hz.description: Exciter band 3 (tape) high-pass on the excited content in Hz.

exciter_band4_mode.description: Exciter band 4 (air) harmonic curve: even, odd, or mix.

exciter_band4_amount.description: Exciter band 4 (air) dry/wet mix of the excited content. 0.0 = neutral.

exciter_band4_drive_db.description: Exciter band 4 (air) drive in dB for the odd/tanh path.

exciter_band4_low_cut_hz.description: Exciter band 4 (air) high-pass on the excited content in Hz.

tape_enabled.description: Enable the real tape saturation model. False = legacy tanh path.

tape_drive_db.description: Tape drive in dB. 0 = neutral (bit-exact bypass).

tape_hysteresis.description: Magnetic memory strength (k, hysteresis recursion). 0 = neutral.

tape_bias.description: Gentle asymmetry (DC offset) — mixes in even harmonics.

tape_hf_shelf_hz.description: HF roll-off corner above which high levels are attenuated.

adaptive_comp_enabled.description: Enable the adaptive (program-dependent) compressor. False = fixed −16 dB stage.

adaptive_comp_threshold_offset_db.description: Margin (dB) below the program RMS at which the adaptive threshold sits. Larger = gentler compression.

adaptive_comp_attack_ms.description: Base attack time used at high program crest (percussion). Scaled down for lower crest.

adaptive_comp_release_ms.description: Base release time used at low program crest (tails, pads). Scaled down for higher crest.

adaptive_comp_makeup_db.description: Makeup gain applied after compression. 0 = none.

delay_enabled.description: Enable the delay stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

delay_mix.description: Dry/wet mix of the delayed signal. 0.0 = no effect (neutral)

delay_feedback.description: Feedback amount for repeated echoes. 0.0 = single repeat (neutral)

echo_enabled.description: Enable the echo stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

echo_mix.description: Dry/wet mix of the echo. 0.0 = no effect (neutral)

echo_feedback.description: Echo feedback — cascading repeats. 0.0 = single repeat (neutral)

reverb_enabled.description: Enable the reverb stage. False = bit-exact bypass.

reverb_mix.description: Dry/wet mix of the reverb. 0.0 = no effect (neutral)

reverb_size.description: Reverb room size / decay. 0.1 = small room, 1.0 = huge hall
